title: AdminNominateOrganizerCallablePayload
description: A Catch sales associate nominates an organizer. Supply Intake builds the listing from the name and links; nothing is published until staff review it. Refused while programmatic listings are paused (listingProgramSettings/platform).

formats.description: The formats the nominator says the organizer runs. Travels to the listing as Supply Intake categories (run_clubs, quiz_nights) and pre-fills the reviewer's choice. Required by the callable; optional in the schema only so an older Admin build gets a clear refusal instead of a validation error. Nightlife is never offered.
